description: Defines internal utilities for uniform random distributions, including range validation, type inference, and distribution bounds handling within the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: uniform_int_distribution
classes.description: Template class for uniform integer distribution (forward declaration).

classes.name: uniform_real_distribution
classes.description: Template class for uniform real distribution (forward declaration).

classes.name: UniformDistributionWrapper
classes.description: Template struct that wraps the appropriate Abseil uniform distribution type, providing constructors with bounds and tags.

methods.name: uniform_lower_bound
methods.description: Calculates the lower bound for uniform distribution based on the tag type and input bounds.

methods.name: uniform_upper_bound
methods.description: Calculates the upper bound for uniform distribution based on the tag type and input bounds.

methods.name: is_uniform_range_valid
methods.description: Checks if the specified range is valid for floating point or integral types.
